note: He is the purest good-to-great case in the batch and the furthest thing from the deconditioned exclusion — 71 kg at 5'11", lean, three training days a week plus a weekly sport plus twice-weekly mobility, and 60 kg weighted dips in his recent history. He wants sharpness, shoulder width and fast-twitch power, which is precisely 'good to great'. He fails the other three. Occupation was never asked in nineteen minutes, so 'successful' is untested on the record — the fourth call in this batch where the ICP's primary screening criterion produced nothing. Income fails on his own words: 'It is definitely above budget for sure' and 'the amount that I need to put aside for this would be considerable, given the fact where I am at right now'. And health is not the neglected area at all — it is the area he manages most deliberately, which is the inverse of the stated profile. This is a prospect who fits the aspiration of the ICP on physical profile while failing it on the two economic criteria, and he is the second in this batch to do so.
